control.description-key: Sign or draw with mouse, pen or touch. Saves the picture as a PNG Note attachment on the current record. Includes eraser, undo, redo and clear, and lets users edit or delete saved images.

property.name: hostField
property.description-key: Any single line text column. Its value is not changed unless 'Fill host field when saved' is Yes.

property.name: padMode
property.description-key: Signature: one signature per record, cropped to the ink. Drawing: a larger canvas with more colours, and a list of saved drawings.

property.name: imageName
property.description-key: File name of the saved picture, without .png. Leave empty to use 'Signature' or 'Drawing'.

property.name: saveBehaviour
property.display-name-key: When a new image is saved
property.description-key: Replace: delete the earlier images with the same name, so the record keeps one. Keep: keep every saved image.

property.name: noteSubject
property.description-key: Title given to the Note. Leave empty to use the image name.

property.name: imageNote
property.description-key: Let users type a short note with each image, for example 'First floor' or the signer's name. Saved in the Note's description and shown with the image.

property.name: penColor
property.description-key: Starting pen colour as a hex code, for example #000000 or #1F3B8C. Leave empty for black.

property.name: penWidth
property.description-key: Starting pen thickness, 1 to 20. Leave empty for 3.

property.name: padHeight
property.description-key: Height of the drawing area. Leave empty for 200 (signature) or 360 (drawing). The width follows the form.

property.name: allowDelete
property.description-key: Show a delete button on saved images. Dataverse security still applies.

property.name: fillHostField
property.description-key: Yes: write the saved file name into the host field (and clear it when the last image is deleted), so the field can be made required or used in views and rules. The form must then be saved.
